##############################################################
## PW Boards..
##
## Note that the variant field is used to pick up the pins_arduino.h from the
## associated folder in esp32/hardware/esp32/3.1.0/variants
##
## Add a new custom menu item

menu.TMVGadget=ThermaV Gadget Config
menu.TMVGRevision=ThermaV Boards Revision

##############################################################

tmvg_esp32.name=TMVG ESP32 Gadget

tmvg_esp32.build.tmvgdefs=-DTMVG_PROJECT
tmvg_esp32.build.tmvgcustom=-DTMVG_ESP32 -DTMVG_SPIFFS -DTMVG_OLED

# Standard options

tmvg_esp32.bootloader.tool=esptool_py
tmvg_esp32.bootloader.tool.default=esptool_py

tmvg_esp32.upload.tool=esptool_py
tmvg_esp32.upload.tool.default=esptool_py
tmvg_esp32.upload.tool.network=esp_ota

tmvg_esp32.upload.maximum_size=1769472
tmvg_esp32.upload.maximum_data_size=327680
tmvg_esp32.upload.flags=
tmvg_esp32.upload.extra_flags=
tmvg_esp32.upload.speed=921600
tmvg_esp32.upload.erase_cmd=

tmvg_esp32.serial.disableDTR=true
tmvg_esp32.serial.disableRTS=true

tmvg_esp32.build.tarch=xtensa
tmvg_esp32.build.bootloader_addr=0x1000
tmvg_esp32.build.target=esp32
tmvg_esp32.build.mcu=esp32
tmvg_esp32.build.core=esp32
tmvg_esp32.build.variant=esp32
tmvg_esp32.build.board=gadget1

tmvg_esp32.build.f_cpu=240000000L
tmvg_esp32.build.flash_size=4MB
tmvg_esp32.build.flash_freq=80m
tmvg_esp32.build.flash_mode=dio
tmvg_esp32.build.boot=dio
tmvg_esp32.build.partitions=4MB_ota_512KB_spiffs

tmvg_esp32.build.loop_core=-DARDUINO_RUNNING_CORE=1
tmvg_esp32.build.event_core=-DARDUINO_EVENT_RUNNING_CORE=1

tmvg_esp32.build.copy_jtag_files=0

# Menu to select board type, not really necessary

tmvg_esp32.menu.TMVGadget.tnode=TNode
tmvg_esp32.menu.TMVGadget.tnode.tmvg.subtype=-DTNODE
tmvg_esp32.menu.TMVGadget.master=master
tmvg_esp32.menu.TMVGadget.master.tmvg.subtype=-DMASTER
tmvg_esp32.menu.TMVGadget.external=external
tmvg_esp32.menu.TMVGadget.external.tmvg.subtype=-DEXTERNAL

# The FQDN will have TMVGRevision=v1, the 'version 1' is shown in the menu

tmvg_esp32.menu.TMVGRevision.v2=version 2

# Debug selection

tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.none=None
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.none.build.code_debug=0
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.error=Error
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.error.build.code_debug=1
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.warn=Warn
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.warn.build.code_debug=2
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.info=Info
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.info.build.code_debug=3
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.debug=Debug
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.debug.build.code_debug=4
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.verbose=Verbose
tmvg_esp32.menu.DebugLevel.verbose.build.code_debug=5

# Using the legacy TMVG_ESP32

tmvg_esp32.build.defines={build.tmvgdefs} {build.tmvgcustom} {tmvg.subtype}

##############################################################

tmvg_wsharelcd.name=TMVG Waveshare LCD
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.tmvgdefs=-DTMVG_PROJECT
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.tmvgcustom=-DTMVG_WAVESHARE_LCDB -DTMVG_LITTLEFS

tmvg_wsharelcd.vid.0=0x303a
tmvg_wsharelcd.pid.0=0x8231
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload_port.0.vid=0x303a
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload_port.0.pid=0x8231

tmvg_wsharelcd.bootloader.tool=esptool_py
tmvg_wsharelcd.bootloader.tool.default=esptool_py

tmvg_wsharelcd.upload.tool=esptool_py
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload.tool.default=esptool_py
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload.tool.network=esp_ota
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload.maximum_size=4718592
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload.maximum_data_size=327680
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload.flags=
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload.extra_flags=
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload.use_1200bps_touch=false
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload.wait_for_upload_port=false
tmvg_wsharelcd.upload.speed=921600

tmvg_wsharelcd.serial.disableDTR=false
tmvg_wsharelcd.serial.disableRTS=false

tmvg_wsharelcd.build.tarch=xtensa
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.bootloader_addr=0x0
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.target=esp32s3
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.mcu=esp32s3
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.core=esp32
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.variant=waveshare_esp32_s3_touch_lcd_43b
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.board=WAVESHARE_ESP32_S3_TOUCH_LCD_43B

tmvg_wsharelcd.build.usb_mode=1
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.cdc_on_boot=1
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.msc_on_boot=0
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.dfu_on_boot=0
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.f_cpu=240000000L

tmvg_wsharelcd.build.flash_size=16MB
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.flash_freq=80m
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.flash_mode=dio
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.boot=qio
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.boot_freq=80m

tmvg_wsharelcd.build.psram_type=opi
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.psram_defines=-DBOARD_HAS_PSRAM
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.memory_type={build.boot}_{build.psram_type}

tmvg_wsharelcd.build.partitions=large_spiffs_16MB

tmvg_wsharelcd.build.loop_core=-DARDUINO_RUNNING_CORE=1
tmvg_wsharelcd.build.event_core=-DARDUINO_EVENT_RUNNING_CORE=1

tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.none=None
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.none.build.code_debug=0
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.error=Error
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.error.build.code_debug=1
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.warn=Warn
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.warn.build.code_debug=2
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.info=Info
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.info.build.code_debug=3
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.debug=Debug
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.debug.build.code_debug=4
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.verbose=Verbose
tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.DebugLevel.verbose.build.code_debug=5


# The FQDN will have TMVGRevision=v1, the 'version 1' is shown in the menu

tmvg_wsharelcd.menu.TMVGRevision.v2=version 2

tmvg_wsharelcd.build.defines={build.tmvgdefs} {build.tmvgcustom} {build.psram_defines}
